SIBA Saturday Morning Ride

Staten Island, NY · New Dorp · Road

SIBA Saturday Morning Ride is a road group ride in Staten Island, NY. It rolls every Saturday at 8:30 am from Miller Field parking lot. Pace: groups by ability.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: groups by ability. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the SIBA Saturday Morning Ride group ride

The Staten Island club's standing Saturday ride. Riders split into groups by ability, and first-timers get some guidance. Non-members can join if they are 18 or older and sign a waiver. The club also runs members-only Sunday rides off the island and occasional casual rides for newer riders.
